summary: controller profile with jog, pad, fader, eq, audio, usb diagnostic groups. Companion workflow(s): rekordbox,Serato DJ Pro.
identityNotes: Research seed; the manufacturer's DDJ-GRV6 Instruction Manual DRI1927A documents USB MIDI control (p. 170), a nominal 48 kHz audio section and 24-bit A/D and D/A converters (p. 168). Nominal sampling and converter resolution do not establish a complete USB format/rate list or channel counts, which remain unknown. USB IDs, class compliance, DIN transport, receiving capability, Identity support, exact control maps, hardware/firmware revision, current OS/driver compatibility and physical performance remain unverified; no factory pass tolerances are inferred.

tests.title: Jog rotation and touch
tests.why: Check jog function on DDJ-GRV6; avoid assumptions about HID or analog routing.
steps: Consult the exact DDJ-GRV6 manual for the relevant connectors and operating mode.
Exercise each jog element on the device and observe MIDI, HID/software response or audio measurement as applicable.
Check slow and fast transitions, all channels/sides, and repeats; save raw evidence and mark unobservable functions as not tested.
equipment: Compatible host software or capture interface when required

tests.title: Groove Circuit Drum Swap/Roll/Release
steps: Run rekordbox for Mac/Windows and load a supported reference track.
Use Drum Swap, then Roll/Trans, then Release; log effects and compare deactivation.
In Serato, check Stems FX instead; do not expect rekordbox Groove Circuit behavior.
